title: Palantir Foundry and cuOpt drive NVIDIA supply chain allocation
slides: Can Palantir fix NVIDIA's supply chain?
Foundry now orchestrates critical allocation decisions
cuOpt solves complex constraints in seconds, not days
Your planning cycles may shrink dramatically
Test one bottleneck with algorithmic allocation
thread_text:
1. Palantir's Supply Chain Fix

NVIDIA's allocation decisions now run through Foundry, and cuOpt crunches constraints in seconds. The bottleneck isn't chips—it's planning speed.

2. Foundry Takes Over Allocations

Critical allocation calls that used to take weeks now happen inside Foundry. Your planning cycles are next.

3. CuOpt Beats the Clock

Complex constraints that took days now resolve in seconds. That speed changes what's possible in a single shift.

4. Planning Cycles Shrink Fast

When allocation runs in seconds, your quarterly planning becomes a daily habit. The org chart may not keep up.

5. Test One Bottleneck Today

Take a real constraint from your line and simulate it with an algorithmic allocator. Does it hold up, or does it break?
